Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and many of them have dedicated vegetarian menus or can accommodate dietary preferences):

| Restaurant | Location | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|------------|----------|-----------------------|-------|
| **Baan Thai** | 1110 W. 18th St., West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | Classic Thai with a separate vegetarian menu; friendly staff who can adjust spice levels. |
| **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1401 N. Clark St., Near North Side | *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | Offers a “vegetarian” section on the menu; also has vegan options. |
| **Thai Orchid** | 2000 W. 31st St., West Side | *Vegetarian Pad Krapow*, *Vegetarian Red Curry*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Vegetables* | Known for generous portions and a dedicated vegetarian menu. |
| **Siam Square** | 400 N. Clark St., Near North Side | *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Papaya Salad* | A popular spot with a separate vegetarian menu; can customize spice levels. |
| **The Thai Kitchen** | 500 W. 18th St., West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | Offers a vegetarian menu and can accommodate vegan requests. |
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1200 W. 18th St., West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Vegetables* | Separate vegetarian menu; friendly staff who can adjust spice levels. |
| **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1401 N. Clark St., Near North Side | *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | Offers a “vegetarian” section on the menu; also has vegan options. |
| **Siam Square** | 400 N. Clark St., Near North Side | *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Papaya Salad* | A popular spot with a separate vegetarian menu; can customize spice levels. |
| **The Thai Kitchen** | 500 W. 18th St., West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | Offers a vegetarian menu and can accommodate vegan requests. |
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1200 W. 18th St., West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Vegetables* | Separate vegetarian menu; friendly staff who can adjust spice levels. |

### How to choose:
1. **Check the menu online** – most of these restaurants post their vegetarian options on their websites or on food‑review sites like Yelp or Google Maps.
2. **Call ahead** – let the staff know you’re vegetarian (or vegan) so they can recommend dishes or adjust recipes.
3. **Ask about spice levels** – Thai food can be spicy; most places can reduce the heat if you prefer milder flavors.

Enjoy your meal!
